MY WEATHER JOURNAL

My Weekly Weather Tracker

Build a seven-day record, then compare what stayed the same and what changed.

Look, then try.

Observe from the same safe place at about the same time each day. You can start on any day. Save your work before closing the page; entries do not stay here between visits. Keep each saved image or use the printable tracker across the week.

Start drawing and writing below

Open the worksheet to print or save

Observe with a grown-up from a safe indoor spot. Never look directly at the sun. Stay indoors during storms. For the toy shelter, test over a tray with adult help and keep devices dry.

Use a finger, stylus or mouse in each drawing box. Type below it, or ask a grown-up to write your words. Your work stays in this tab. Save before refreshing or leaving.

What are we learning?

A week of observations shows weather during that week. Climate describes patterns over much longer periods.
